## Design decisions recorded at implementation

- **`DelegateSpec` home:** `lower_procedure`'s `subagent_task`
  product is a `DelegateNode{spec, budget, permission}` — the
  `RuntimePlan/1` `delegate` node — whose `spec` is the
  canonical `SubagentSpec` document. The spec *schema* stays
  owned by `hh-subagent` (`SubagentSpec::{to,from}_json`, CC7);
  the compiler carries it as data (the same shape a declared
  `ProcedureStep::Delegate{spec}` carries today). The
  constructor `hh_subagent::task::spec_for_procedure` builds
  the typed spec (goal = `P` + bound parameters, grants over
  `allowed_capabilities`, ceiling `delegate`, fresh context),
  `SubagentSpec::from_json` round-trips the plan node's spec
  for `spawn` (CC1/CC4).
- **`subagent_task` refusals:** `DelegationUnavailable` stays a
  live refusal — the honest typed error when the subagent path
  is demanded (override or `I(P)` ∧ bound ∧ declared fails to
  hold) but the runtime cannot delegate; rule (iii) now
  *selects* `SubagentTask` under `I(P)` ∧ `subagents_bound` ∧
  `profile_declares_subagents` (AC-R-2.4.5-5's four-refusal
  set is unchanged).
- **Ranker family:** `RankerDeclaration` is data per variant;
  the kernel registers `deterministic_default`,
  `structural_pagerank`, `lexical_weighted`,
  `recency_importance` (all `deterministic = true`,
  `required_inputs` empty beyond the request) plus the
  declared-but-unbound `similarity_rerank`
  (`deterministic = false`, `required_inputs` =
  `{ModelProfile(pinned embedder), ResourceAccount}` —
  `EmbedderUnpinned` until pinned). `report.deterministic`
  reads the declaration, not a hard-coded table (CC1).
- **Summarizer port:** `Summarize` execution is gated on a
  declared `summarizer_profile` in the proposal plus a bound
  `Summarizer` port — the only op that may call a model, and
  only through the caller's gateway (I-BUDGET; the port is a
  caller-supplied trait so offline runs wire a deterministic
  stub). `input_reduction` applies on `SummarizerOverflow` and
  is recorded `input_reduction_applied` (spec §5c.2 row:
  declared `InputReduction` applied and recorded, then success
  or fallback).
- **`memory_store` port:** the plugin contract surface is the
  record op set `{put, bind, revoke, resolve, manifest,
  enumerate, stale_candidates, reads_of, writes_by,
  record_read, set_stamp, set_validator_verdict,
  mark_scope_ended, publish_replacement}` — the same surface
  `retrieve`/`lifecycle`/`consolidate` read. `MemoryStorePort`
  is the kernel-side trait both bindings satisfy; the C1
  battery runs the conformance suite against the in-process
  store and the spawned `hh-memory-store` plugin
  interchangeably.
- **Boundary companion:** `lab/compaction-boundary-v1` is an
  `ExperimentSpec` (`comparative`, `paired`) whose task
  coordinates are `context.compaction.started` event refs
  (`fork_by_reference`, `environment_derivation =
  fork_snapshot`) with `eval_budget` on `turns = 5` matched
  across the two arms (`applied`/`withheld`); unequal arm
  budgets refuse `UnmatchedBudget` — matched-budget-or-refuse
  (CC9), never an uneven comparison.
- **`adopt` lowering:** `adopt_with` gains
  `AdoptInputs{loss_report?, coverage}` — the caller supplies
  the incremental lifter's `LoweringLossReport` and a
  coverage oracle over the run's grant set (`permission_
  coverage` recomputed, typically `uncovered` until a grant
  exists); `adopt` keeps its C1 signature delegating with the
  empty context (CC8). The results row carries
  `configuration_drift = true` + `catalog_epochs[]` folded
  from `action.tool.catalog.epoch` rows (the projection's
  additive member — `hh-results-row/1` `lineage` section).

## Fix found by verification

- **Remote plugin `put` presented as `InvocationTimeout`.**
  The spawned battery's first `put` hung — the host's V1
  inbound screen reads a stored `MemoryVersion`'s own
  `label.authority = kernel` member as a forged plugin
  envelope claim (`AuthorityCrossing` drop → host waits out
  the 20 s timeout). Fixed by wrapping record outputs as
  canonical JSON strings under `{result: "…"}` — stored
  records stay data, the screen stays strict (ADR-0310 D5).
- **Removability run must be serial.** A first attempt
  launched concurrently with `cargo test --workspace`
  failed `helper socket never appeared` (spawn timeout
  under load) and left `target/debug/hh-helper` as the
  tier-0 build — the workspace suite's `helper_live` block
  then recorded 8 environmental failures (honest
  `preserve_until requires tier-c1` refusals, not code).
  Rebuilt the helper, re-ran `helper_live` 15/15, then the
  removability script serially — green on every stanza;
  the workspace suite re-ran clean afterward.

## Notes / deviations

- **`similarity` stays declared-but-unbound** — the embedder
  pin is a Stage-5 decision; every similarity request
  refuses `EmbedderUnpinned` until then.
- **The judge critic is not this ticket** — the judged
  fidelity *declaration* + the `emit_judged` emission path
  land here so `lab/compaction-boundary-v1` can name its
  optional metric; §05f's critic/verdict depth is S4.16c.
- **`applied_ops_source = "format"`** — a hosted compaction
  record without reported ops gets the format default
  `[{kind: summarize}]` stamped as inference, never as
  reported data (CC2).
